# Negative composition inputs

These literal negative cases belong to the standalone vocabulary composition
catalogue test boundary. They are not proof of compiler/project/codec activation.
See the parent fixture README for ownership and the pinned conformance manifest.

`requests.json` adds frozen source shape/tag/payload/public-closure diagnostics,
required-reference omission/type errors, length restrictions and hostile
dependency/embedded-cycle/executable-member cases. Do not count future source
diagnostics as passing compiler tests merely because their literals are pinned.
